headline: Request for a school bus camera pilot, a possible move of administrative offices, and a budget modification.
summary: The agenda includes motions on a school bus camera pilot, paycheck timing, and moving administrative offices. It also covers a budget modification, a donation, surplus equipment, student travel, sick leave donations, and an executive session on bargaining and facility leases.
items: Memorial for Amy L. Cloutier, paraprofessional at McAuliffe Elementary School
Motion: outline when the last paycheck of SY26-2027 and the first paycheck of SY27-28 will be furnished, and the number of days between pay periods
Motion: path forward for a pilot camera program on selected school buses that transport Lowell students
Motion: explore moving LPS 4th and 5th floor administrative offices from Merrimack Street to another location in the city
Approval to accept and expend allocated FY27 award
Letter of approval for accepting donation from Greater Lowell Community Foundation (GLCF)
Request for approval to recycle or dispose of surplus and unserviceable equipment
Out-of-state overnight travel: AFJROTC Drill Team, Daytona Beach, FL
Overnight out-of-state travel: Winterguard International Competition, Tom River, NJ
Out-of-state overnight travel: WGI Competition, Dayton, Ohio
Overnight request: MASBO Conference, Falmouth, MA
Sick leave donation from United Teachers of Lowell: 12 days to Chelsea Morel, Sullivan School teacher, and 14 days to Corey Silva, Greenhalge School paraprofessional
Executive session: collective bargaining, strategies, and possible litigation; negotiations with unions; facilities leases and uses
location: City Council Chamber, 375 Merrimack Street, 2nd Floor, Lowell, MA 01852
